done_when: Every role file opens with a Read-first line naming its source file; role_loader lint fails when a role lacks one; the rules-answer rule is in the roles boot text; a stale budget reading is labelled with its age in the answer.
goal: A model that answers any question about current rules, roles, the super session or budget must read the current source file in that turn, cite file:line and the source commit date, and say NOT_IN_DATA when it did not read it.
scope_in: scripts/dev/role_loader.py; MyTradingSys/system/roles/*.md (one Read-first line each); MyTradingSys/tests/test_role_roster.py
scope_out: trading code; the live tree; the content of the rules themselves
steps: Write the failing lint case first and see it fail
Add the Read-first line to every role file
Make lint enforce it; run check and lint
tests: MyTradingSys/tests/test_role_roster.py: new case fails now (role files without a Read-first line), passes after the change
title: BUG (high): Haiku answers rule, role and super-session questions from stale or unread files
